scope: Read both QA sources in full; reread the final report-completeness patch; inspect representative site slider labels and the 150-ms verification explorer debounce. This is source review, not browser evidence.

slider_review.settling: Each minimum, maximum and restored initial value dispatches input/change, awaits two requestAnimationFrame callbacks, then waits 250 ms. This covers the inspected 150-ms debounce scheduling interval before collecting smoke evidence.
slider_review.actual_label_conventions: Associated IDs use slider-id plus -val or -v, matching inspected site markup. Associated nodes are captured first, with a bounded collection of nearby readouts.
slider_review.scope_is_explicit: The report labels this Input/error smoke and explorerNumericalCorrectness=not_checked. It checks retained input values, rendered-math problems and runtime errors; readout text is evidence for review, not an expected-numerical-output assertion.
slider_review.limits: A fixed settling delay is not a general completion oracle for arbitrary future asynchronous work or a proof that explorer computations are correct.

blocked_and_incomplete_run_review.launch_failure: Explicit blocked row preserves requestedFiles and QA hashes, marks browser checks blocked/skipped, writes the report and rethrows. It cannot reach normal passing finalization.
blocked_and_incomplete_run_review.requested_inventory: Every requested filename has a persisted pending row before browser launch. Interruptions cannot leave only a successful prefix without the remaining inventory.
blocked_and_incomplete_run_review.page_progress: The same indexed row is written as running before source/page work; page/helper failures and page cleanup/fingerprint failures are caught and recorded.
blocked_and_incomplete_run_review.completion: Finally writes passed/failed for the current row, retaining unvisited pending rows. Empty reports and any status other than passed yield nonzero exit.
blocked_and_incomplete_run_review.snapshot_integrity: Writing to a temporary sibling and renaming preserves the last valid JSON snapshot on interruption.

fingerprint_and_artifact_review.identified_sources: Per-page primary HTML SHA256 and both QA script hashes; HTML is fingerprinted again after page work and a change fails the page.
fingerprint_and_artifact_review.artifacts: Screenshot/PDF paths, byte counts and content SHA256 are recorded when artifacts are written; their primary HTML hash is attached.
fingerprint_and_artifact_review.honest_visual_scope: Screenshot/PDF visualInspection remains pending. Generated artifacts and automated status do not claim manual visual approval.
fingerprint_and_artifact_review.dependency_limit: Shared CSS/JS and external rendering dependencies are not included in the runner fingerprint set. Their later edits require separate source/version evidence; the present site is frozen.

findings.issue: An interrupted normal run could leave only prior passed rows, without requested inventory or an incomplete marker.
findings.resolution: The final runner persists full pending inventory, running rows and caught failures, uses atomic report replacement, and fails its final exit status for nonpassed or empty inventories.

existing_browser_evidence_observed.interpretation: The final reviewed runner was attempted by root. The saved report matches both final QA hashes, preserves all 29 requested filenames, and explicitly records launch blockage from the sandbox Operation not permitted failure. Browser-dependent checks remain skipped; no rendered or interaction success is established.

limits: No browser execution, syntax/test execution, site edit or proof edit by this reviewer.
The author reports node --check success; this reviewer did not independently execute it.
No claim of rendered correctness, keyboard/print runtime success, manual screenshot approval or numerical explorer correctness.
Only book/review/browser-qa-peer.json was written for this review.
